candidate_merges.message: Add CLI shell completion generation and installer integration (#20026) ## Description Make the Aspire CLI easier to discover and use through shell tab completion, and configure completion during installation where the installer has a suitable user-shell integration mechanism. Adds `aspire completions script [bash|fish|pwsh|zsh]`. Generated hooks query the live command model for commands, subcommands, options, and completion-enabled values without requiring `dotnet-suggest`. Requests avoid normal

candidate_merges.message: Add docked REPL commands for database and cache integrations (#20231) ## Description Make it possible to query local databases and caches directly from the Aspire dashboard without installing clients or copying credentials into a separate terminal. Adds an explicitly opt-in **REPL** resource command for PostgreSQL, Redis, Valkey, MongoDB, MySQL, and SQL Server. Each integration exposes a typed `WithRepl()` extension.
